original_text:
Exciting news! Our lab has been awarded an ISF Breakthrough Grant to investigate how subcortical signals shape inter-areal cortical interactions during motor learning.
We are now recruiting PhD students and postdoctoral fellows. 
Interested? Send me a message or email.
chinese_translation:
激动人心的消息！我们的实验室获得了ISF突破性资助，用于研究皮层下信号如何在运动学习过程中塑造区域间皮层相互作用。
我们现在正在招收博士生和博士后研究员。
感兴趣？请给我发私信或邮件。
research_focus: Motor learning, subcortical signals, cortical interactions

institution: Human Technopole / Politecnico di Milano (Italy) / FIMM Helsinki
original_text:
🚀 We’re hiring PhD students to join my group at Human Technopole! 

Work on AI, foundation models, LLMs, EHRs, human genetics, and population-scale health data. 

PhD via Politecnico di Milano. 

Apply 28 Jul–7 Sep 2026. 

Details: https://lnkd.in/dAwK4Gka
chinese_translation:
🚀 我们正在招聘博士生加入我在Human Technopole的团队！

研究方向：AI、基础模型、大语言模型、电子健康记录、人类遗传学以及人口规模健康数据。

通过米兰理工大学（Politecnico di Milano）攻读博士学位。

申请时间：2026年7月28日至9月7日。

详情：https://lnkd.in/dAwK4Gka
research_focus: AI + foundation models + human genetics + population-scale health data
application_notes: Apply 28 Jul–7 Sep 2026 via Politecnico di Milano

original_text: Recruiting PhD students for Fall 27, we focus on education & equitable access to effective supports for children & families. If you are interested in implementation science, interdisciplinary partnerships, & applied research that bridges evidence, policy, & practice, lets talk!
chinese_translation: 正在招收2027年秋季入学的博士生，我们专注于教育以及儿童和家庭获得有效支持的公平性。如果你对实施科学、跨学科合作以及连接证据、政策与实践的应用研究感兴趣，欢迎联系！
research_focus: Education, equity, implementation science for children and families

original_text: Two PhD Positions in Public Economics and Political Economy at the University of Lausanne (IDHEAP). Conduct original research leading to a PhD dissertation in public economics, political economy, or at their intersection under supervision of Prof. Laure Athias. Deadline: 1 Oct 2026. Start: 1 Oct 2026 or later.
chinese_translation: 洛桑大学（IDHEAP）公共经济学与政治经济学方向招收2名博士生。在Laure Athias教授指导下开展原创研究。申请截止：2026年10月1日。入职时间：2026年10月1日或之后。
application_notes: Deadline 1 Oct 2026; Master's in Economics or equivalent; strong quantitative skills

author_handle: Prof. dr. Ruud Wouters (via Hasselt University)
original_text: PhD Student: Protest Politics (2 mandates). Analyzing how protests shape public opinion. Political Science and International Relations. Deadline: Aug 17, 2026. Requires Master's in social sciences and quantitative research skills.
chinese_translation: 哈瑟尔特大学招收抗议政治方向博士生（2个名额）。研究抗议如何塑造公众舆论。政治科学与国际关系。截止：2026年8月17日。需要社会科学硕士学位和定量研究技能。

original_text: PhD Position in Public Economics at the Chair of Public Economics. 100% PhD position with research and teaching assistant responsibilities, up to 4 years, starting around September 2026. Empirically oriented research in public economics.
chinese_translation: 弗里堡大学公共经济学教席招收博士生（100%职位，含研究与教学助理职责），最长4年，约2026年9月开始。实证导向的公共经济学研究。
application_notes: Starting ~Sep 2026; Master's in economics; strong empirical methods

original_text: I am recruiting PhD students to join my research group! If you're interested in systems or security (including intersections with cryptography, datacenters, AI, etc.), then please apply to UCLA Computer Science (@UCLAComSci) and list me on your application as a potential advisor.
chinese_translation: 我正在招收博士生加入我的研究组！如果你对系统或安全（包括与密码学、数据中心、AI等的交叉领域）感兴趣，请申请UCLA计算机科学并在申请中将我列为潜在导师。
application_notes: Apply to UCLA CS and list as potential advisor

original_text: We're getting close to PhD application time. I'm looking for PhD students and post-docs to join our lab to work on reinforcement learning! If interested, make sure to mention my name in your statement and/or fill out the expression of interest form below!
chinese_translation: 博士申请季快到了。我正在寻找博士生和博士后加入我们的实验室，从事强化学习研究！如果感兴趣，请务必在个人陈述中提及我的名字，并/或填写下方的意向表达表格！
application_notes: Mention name in statement + expression of interest form

original_text: I am recruiting PhD students as HKU now. Welcome top students who are passionate about machine intelligence to apply -- better with a good background in computing and mathematics.
chinese_translation: 我现在以香港大学身份招收博士生。欢迎对机器智能充满热情的优秀学生申请——最好有扎实的计算和数学背景。

original_text: PhD position in my lab on Perturbation-based Multi-omics Inference of Gene Regulatory Networks. Based on a deep learning framework to efficiently connect gene perturbations and multimodal data. Apply by February 22. https://sonnhammer.org/download/ads/open.html
chinese_translation: 我实验室有博士职位，研究方向为基于扰动的多组学基因调控网络推断。基于深度学习框架高效连接基因扰动和多模态数据。申请截止日期2月22日。详情见链接。
research_focus: Gene Regulatory Networks, Multi-omics, Deep Learning
